headline: Registered Nurse (Enfermeiro/a)
summary: Registered Nurse with an active Cédula Profissional da Ordem dos Enfermeiros and 2 years of clinical experience in a hospital inpatient setting. Responsible for routine patient care, administering medication, and monitoring vital signs in general medical wards.

experience.title: Registered Nurse (Enfermeiro/a) - Inpatient Ward
bullets: Provided daily nursing care to patients admitted to the general medicine inpatient ward.
Prepared and administered prescribed oral and intravenous medications according to medical charts.
Monitored and recorded patient vital signs at scheduled intervals during shifts.
Assisted patients with personal hygiene, mobility, and feeding.
Communicated patient status updates to doctors and other nurses during shift handovers.

experience.title: Outpatient Clinic Nurse
bullets: Performed routine wound dressings and suture removals in an outpatient clinic.
Collected blood and urine samples for laboratory testing.
Managed nursing supplies and restocked consultation rooms.

education.degree: Bachelor's degree in Nursing (Licenciatura em Enfermagem)
education.institution: Escola Superior de Saúde de Santarém

certifications: Valid and active Cédula Profissional da Ordem dos Enfermeiros
